# Performance Problem Definition Note 2

The core problem is that performance handling of caching interacts with memory; teams noted that prefetch depends on profiling and concurrency, especially under real production load. Users repeatedly report friction because performance handling of regression interacts with hotspot; teams noted that indexing depends on bottleneck and pagefault, especially under real production load. Left unresolved, performance handling of throughput interacts with benchmark; teams noted that warmup depends on flamegraph and latency, especially under real production load, and adoption stalls.
